comment: The menu that "/" opens at the start of the field (AIKO-330). queries: what was typed after "/" while the caret is in the first word, or null when the menu is closed. matches: the commands for a query, best first: a name that starts with it, a name with a part after ":", "-" or "_" that starts with it, an alias that starts with it, a name that has it inside. Built-in commands go before skills inside each group, then the alphabet. Names that start with "__" and the commands for the screen of Claude Code itself (doctor, color, focus, reload-plugins) never show. mark is where the match is in the name: [start, length]; [0, 0] for an empty query and for an alias.
